name: M5.PhysicalBridge.remaining_gcd_feasible
statement: ∀ (T : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ) (e : ℕ), e ∈ A → M5.Connectivity.supportGcd T A B = 1 → Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd T (M5.PhysicalBridge.remainingGcd A B e)) e = 1
guidance: Use insert_erase for e in A and Finset.gcd_insert, then gcd associativity/commutativity. No positivity assumption is needed for this exact algebraic identity. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
